Leave the bright lights of Sin City behind for a private 2-day tour of Lake Powell, Antelope Canyon, Horseshoe Bend and Zion National Park. You'll stop at some of the most popular Southwest attractions such as the Big Water Dinosaur Center and the Glen Canyon Dam. Enjoy expert commentary from your private guide, meals per itinerary and 3-star hotel accommodations. This package is exclusive to Viator and cannot be booked anywhere else!
